name: AgentFirstStack
description: Web analytics, tag management with server-side conversion tracking, and email inboxes for AI agents. Each skill runs AgentFirstStack tools: send a data part {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}}; send plain text to get the tool list.

bearer.description: An afs_ API key from POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/signup (one request, no email), or an OAuth access token.

skills.name: Web analytics
skills.description: Run analytics_* tools: create a site and get its snippet, verify the install, stats by country, page, source and device, goals, funnels, realtime, server events, read-only SQL.

skills.name: Tags and conversion tracking
skills.description: Run tags_* tools: containers, site scan, conversion setup for GA4, Google Ads, Meta and TikTok, test events, publish, event log.

skills.name: Email inboxes
skills.description: Run mail_* tools: create an inbox, wait for a verification email with the code and link extracted, read, reply, send, custom domains, webhooks.

skills.name: Account and handover
skills.description: Run afs_* tools, such as afs_create_claim_link, which gives the owner a link to claim the project with Google sign-in.

skills.name: List tools
skills.description: Send any plain-text message to get every tool available to your key and how to call it.
